Install MLNX_OFED or DOCA/DOCA-OFED if this host will use GPFS/WekaFS userspace RDMA, Lustre/NFS-RDMA, or NVMe/NVMe-oF nvidia-fs/nvfs mode with GDS storage-stack patches.

  https://docs.nvidia.com/doca/sdk/doca-host-installation-and-upgrade/index.html#storage-installation
